items.title: Art Farmer — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Joe Harris or Osie Johnson on drums... I made maybe two or three records with George. He always used Bill Evans and more or less the same people who were on the first record.

ctx.x: Wynton Kelly, yeah. Joe Harris was on drums sometimes, or Wesley Landers. Bass player was Aaron Bell. Aaron played later on with Duke Ellington’s band. Good players. There wasn’t nothing wrong with that.
What happened to the drummer, Wesley Landers? I haven’t heard of him.
